Adam Arous.note: Arous's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Adam Arous.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Ali Abdi.summary: Ali Abdi is a Tunisia left-back at Nice who gives the national team overlap timing, crossing quality, and wide defending.
Ali Abdi.note: Abdi is defined by choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Ali Abdi.noteZh: 他靠从后场加入进攻的启动时机与同位置球员拉开差异。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Amine Ben Hmida.summary: Mohamed Amine Ben Hamida is a Tunisia left-back at Espérance de Tunis who gives the national team defensive width, left-footed balance, and tournament experience.
Amine Ben Hmida.note: Hamida stands out for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Amine Ben Hmida.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Anis Slimane.summary: Anis Ben Slimane is a Tunisia attacking midfielder at Norwich City who gives the national team carrying power, between-lines receiving, and midfield height.
Anis Slimane.note: Slimane stands out for receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Anis Slimane.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Aymen Dahmen.note: Dahmen is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Aymen Dahmen.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Dylan Bronn.note: Bronn stands out for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Dylan Bronn.noteZh: 他的突出特点是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Elias Achouri.note: Achouri's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Elias Achouri.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Elias Saad.note: Saad's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Elias Saad.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Ellyes Skhiri.note: Skhiri stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ellyes Skhiri.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Firas Chaouat.note: Chaouat's edge is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Firas Chaouat.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Hannibal Mejbri.note: Mejbri is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Hannibal Mejbri.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Hazem Mastouri.note: Mastouri stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Hazem Mastouri.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Ismael Gharbi.note: Gharbi stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ismael Gharbi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Khalil Ayari.note: Ayari's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Khalil Ayari.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.note: Mahmoud's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Montassar Talbi.note: Talbi is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Montassar Talbi.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Mortadha Ben Ouanes.note: Watch Ouanes for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Mortadha Ben Ouanes.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。留意他如何传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mouhib Chamakh.summary: Abdelmouhib Chamakh is a Tunisia goalkeeper at Club Africain who gives the national team shot-stopping depth, height, and domestic title-winning rhythm.
Mouhib Chamakh.note: Watch Chamakh for staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Mouhib Chamakh.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Moutaz Neffati.note: Neffati stands out for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Moutaz Neffati.noteZh: 他的突出特点是防线暴露后的回追速度。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Omar Rekik.note: Rekik's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Omar Rekik.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Raed Chikhaoui.summary: Raed Chikhaoui is a Tunisia centre-back at US Monastir who gives the national team size, aerial defending, and fresh back-line depth.
Raed Chikhaoui.note: Chikhaoui's signature is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Raed Chikhaoui.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Rani Khedira.note: Khedira stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Rani Khedira.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Rayan Elloumi.note: Elloumi is defined by waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Rayan Elloumi.noteZh: 他靠等防守者注意力转移后再启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Sabri Ben Hessen.note: Hessen is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Sabri Ben Hessen.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Sebastian Tounekti.note: Tounekti's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Sebastian Tounekti.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构上。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Yan Valery.note: Watch Valery for using strength without slowing the next action. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Yan Valery.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。留意他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。
